buyer_of_record_note: All figures are per $100,000 of current annual NOI. They are not this asset's value.

assumptions.name: Going-in capitalisation rate for this asset at 2026
assumptions.why: No official series publishes QSR NNN transaction cap rates. Range spans a 25 bp premium to the 10-year Treasury (4.86%, verified C01) and a typical net-lease spread.

assumptions.name: Cap-rate term adjustment
assumptions.value: -25 bp for 10+ yrs of term; 0 for 5–10; +50 bp for 2–5; +100 bp under 2 yrs
assumptions.why: Standard net-lease term pricing: buyers pay up for long contracted income and discount short remaining term. Direction is uncontroversial; the size is a judgement.

assumptions.name: NOI growth, base case
assumptions.why: Bracket: 2.0% is a conservative floor; 3.7% is the verified September 2026 LA CPI-U (E18). Tenant rent growth above CPI is not assumed.

assumptions.name: Selling costs
assumptions.why: Broker plus closing costs, excluding taxes.

assumptions.name: Basis and accumulated depreciation
assumptions.value: basis = 40% of current value; depreciation taken = 30% of current value
assumptions.why: The brief does not disclose the owner's basis. Both figures are placeholders, and the after-tax ranking is re-run across the range in the sensitivity grid.

assumptions.name: Federal long-term capital gains + net investment income tax
assumptions.why: Statutory top rate for a high-income individual (IRC §1(h) + §1411).

assumptions.name: California income tax on the gain
assumptions.why: Top marginal FTB rate; no preferential capital-gains rate.

assumptions.name: Replacement asset after a §1031 exchange (diversified net lease)
assumptions.value: 6.25% entry and exit cap, 2.5% NOI growth
assumptions.why: With the same cap on entry and exit the yield cancels and only NOI growth matters, so the tested range is on growth, not on the cap.

assumptions.name: Probability the tenant renews at expiry
assumptions.why: The tenant has historically renewed at market rates, but carries negative equity (T05) and a closure programme. Not an official statistic.

assumptions.name: Downtime if the tenant vacates at expiry
assumptions.value: 12 months, then reletting at 90% of prior NOI
assumptions.why: A drive-through QSR box is single-purpose; reletting or re-tenanting takes time.

assumptions.name: Tenant default hazard, any year
assumptions.why: Anchored to the tenant's FY2025 loss and negative equity, not to a published default probability.

assumptions.name: Earthquake loss given a major event
assumptions.value: 8% of value uninsured/retained, plus 10% of one year's NOI
assumptions.why: The 30-year M≥6.7 probability (60%, H01) is official; the loss-given-event is not.

assumptions.name: Wildfire loss given a major event
assumptions.why: Central Los Angeles is urban; the parcel's FHSZ class is unknown (H05 blank). Treated as a small but non-zero tail.

assumptions.name: Renewal rent relative to in-place rent
assumptions.why: A renewal at market is assumed flat; the brief gives no rent and no market comps.

S1.name: Sell now through a §1031 exchange
S1.detail: Sell in 2026, roll the proceeds into a diversified net-lease portfolio under IRC §1031, hold that portfolio to 2040 and sell it then.

S2.name: Sell now, pay the tax
S2.detail: Same 2026 sale but no exchange: federal and California tax is paid on the gain and on depreciation recapture, and the net proceeds are reinvested.

S3.name: Blend-and-extend now, sell in 2032
S3.detail: Negotiate an extension now (target 10 years at or above in-place rent), then sell in 2032 with roughly 4–9 years of term left, through a §1031 exchange.

S4.name: Hold to expiry, then sell
S4.detail: Leave the lease alone. At the 2030–2035 expiry either the tenant renews on market terms or the box goes dark; sell at or near expiry either way.

S5.name: Renew at expiry and hold to 2040
S5.detail: Wait for expiry, renew then, and hold the asset to 2040 collecting rent.
